description: Generator-only Pass@k (%) of the fine-tuned Phi-2 + QLoRA generator. Values copied exactly from the Pass@k table in the original README (commit 0a7cff6). The train/eval columns match the splits and k values of src/verifier/generate_verifier_data.py (7 sampled solutions per question, max 96 new tokens); its outputs (verifier_data/) are not included in this repo, so those values cannot be recomputed here. The test values are reproduced, together with k = 3, 5, 7, by src/analysis/summarize_test_samples.py from results/group_*.json (see results/test_sample_stats.json).

train_2000q.split: GSM8K train split, questions 0-1999 (verifier/ranker training data)

eval_500q.split: GSM8K train split, questions 2000-2499 (held out from verifier/ranker training)

test_1319q.split: GSM8K test split, 15 samples per question (temperature 0.7, top-p 0.9)
